audit_items.proof_trace: The Decimal type uses u256 internally (WAD=10^18); no u128 cast exists anywhere in the accrual path. Every arithmetic operation (mul, add) calls ensure_decimal_value_safe which asserts the result is at most VALUE_MAX_256 = U64_MAX * WAD ≈ 1.844e37, far below U128_MAX. The intermediate product a.value*b.value before division is at most (1.844e37)^2 ≈ 3.4e74, which fits within u256_MAX ≈ 1.158e77, so no silent overflow occurs.
